title: Concept: Legacy cipher with RUN openssl enc -des -in app.tar -out app.enc (dockerfile) — review required
description: In dockerfile build or script text, RUN openssl enc -des -in app.tar -out app.enc selects a single DES family cipher. DES keys are short enough to brute force and the mode provides no integrity, so protected data is recoverable and tampering is silent. Re-encrypt with an authenticated cipher and passphrase KDF (a modern authenticated cipher).
applicability: Dockerfiles and shell scripts that run openssl enc; lexical scope.
risk: Recoverable ciphertext and undetected modification; MEDIUM severity.
